name: pitch-tunnel
description: Preview launcher for the self-contained PITCH TUNNEL HTML game.

scripts.dev: node --eval "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const a=process.argv.slice(1);let host='0.0.0.0',port=7100;for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++){if(a[i]==='--port')port=Number(a[++i]);if(a[i]==='--host'&&a[i+1]&&!a[i+1].startsWith('--'))host=a[++i];}http.createServer((req,res)=>{if(req.url==='/favicon.ico'){res.writeHead(204);res.end();return;}fs.readFile(path.join(process.cwd(),'index.html'),(e,d)=>{if(e){res.writeHead(500);res.end('Preview unavailable');return;}res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':'text/html; charset=utf-8','Cache-Control':'no-store'});res.end(d);});}).listen(port,host,()=>console.log('PITCH TUNNEL preview on http://'+host+':'+port));" --
